race.description: Ladbrokes Tote Win +10% In October (Bm60) Hcp
race.comment: BRITISH GEM (11) is the one to beat with her latest eighth at this track better treated than the bare margin after she raced wide from the 800m as favourite. Her fourth in a 4yo Quality at Cairns the run prior reads well for this, she gets clear weight relief, and two wins from three starts here reads well. MAGIC IN ME (10) is the veteran danger after a sound second in a BM55 at Mackay, with his wet-track record a genuine asset. In the mix. BETA BETTER (6) comes through the key local form having beaten EAGLE WARRIOR by two lengths in a BM55 at this track and distance, and her course-and-distance credentials keep her right in the contest. LONE FORCE (3) has been consistent, was beaten a nose in a BM68 at Bowen, and brings enough recent substance to be a genuine winning player despite still chasing a win at this trip.
